measurement_contract.backaction: Independent preparations make all10 means refer to the same premeasurement state; incompatible values are not assigned jointly to a single copy.
measurement_contract.external_reference: The Stinespring isometry tensors with any spectator reference; initialized apparatus and a classical10-setting schedule are supplied.
measurement_contract.kraus: K+-=(I+-eta A)/2, K0=sqrt((I-eta^2 A^2)/2), A=O/R, eta=1/2
measurement_contract.memory_and_preparation_work: The source preparation costs its actual energy relative to the chosen reference. Reset and schedule work are not claimed zero.
measurement_contract.numerical_work_scope: Full60-state Kraus evaluation is diagnostic; exact completeness, probability formulas and analytic work bounds are the certificate.
measurement_contract.source_work_bound: |Delta E|<=||H||*(3 eta^2/2); exact rational row bound used for ||H||
measurement_contract.trace_norm_disturbance_upper_exact: 3/8 for any input and quantum reference

same_state_sampling.method: Hoeffding: 2 exp(-N epsilon^2/(2 M_j^2)) <=2 exp(-L)<2*2^-L; union over10 settings.

source.H: native_symbol(I).total, including its declared magnetic scalar
source.carrier: All60 spin/internal columns of the declared one-cell native Wilson symbol; no column or measurement outcome discarded.
source.clock: Every setting is acquired at the same specified native time0 on an independently prepared copy; arbitrary common time requires evolving each copy with this same H.
source.metric: Three explicit compact staggered profiles of native observable means; the readout assignment is declared, not a derived spacetime metric.
source.preparation: rho=I60/120+|psi><psi|/2, psi=(3|0>+4|17>)/5; a full-rank supplied state.
source.source_status: Inherited native-coordinate one-particle symbol with supplied noncommuting links/coframe; no normalizable full spatial-field embedding or native12-port generation is inferred.
source.stress: Six exact coframe derivatives from native_strain; T00=H and three native covariant momenta are derivatives of supplied lapse and shift couplings.

tensor_transfer.conditional_tensor_theorem: For acquired null residual qhat and variation tauhat: delta=(2+sqrt(3))*(qhat+8*Cmax*epsilon)+tauhat+2*Cmax*epsilon; |B-lambda eta|<=delta. For acquired divergence what at spacing a=1, each connected lambda step <=what+8*Cmax*epsilon+8*delta.
